human_instruction: Rename the Pi extension builder command semantics from builder-plan to builder-context. Replace the plan-oriented prompt with a bounded context-preparation prompt. Add /kajiya-builder-context as the official command. Keep /kajiya-builder-plan as a deprecated alias that uses the same context prompt. The prompt must tell Pi not to invent strategy, roadmap, or implementation plan. It should read deterministic repo state and docs/task-briefs/ISSUE_ID.json, then prepare bounded Builder context for a human-directed implementation task.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify Python CLI files.
Do not modify docs/state/backlog.json or docs/state/current-project.json from the extension.
Do not make Pi responsible for strategy, roadmap, or planning.
